profile.summary: YouthBeat is an Oakland nonprofit that gives young people free media training in video production and filmmaking. Its classes are offered through Oakland Unified School District and Laney College. Graduates and experienced students can also get paid work through its media production company, YouthBeat PRO.

sources.title: Get In Touch with Oakland's Free Media Training Nonprofit — YouthBeat

review.notes: Oakland youth media-training nonprofit YouthBeat (EIN 99-2013083, PO Box 30071 Oakland) matches the agenda's Oakland 'Youth Beat' workplace-training/internship MOU; ProPublica and GuideStar confirm the 501(c)(3), and the site confirms OUSD/Laney partnership, PRO production arm, and the contact details (a generic org email, not an individual's). Summary is neutral and supported.
